description: Given an Airflow task that uses AirbyteTriggerSyncOperator, AirbyteSensor, or AirbyteHook pointed at a self-hosted Airbyte Server instance, convert it to an Orchestra pipeline YAML task under the AIRBYTE_SERVER integration, with connection_id carried over verbatim into parameters.connection_id and the self-hosted host/credentials represented via a connection: field rather than inline.

evals.prompt: Convert this Airflow DAG to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/airbyte_server_single_sync.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single AIRBYTE_SERVER task running AIRBYTE_SERVER_JOB, with parameters.connection_id set to 2b4c6d8e-0a1b-4c2d-8e3f-4a5b6c7d8e9f (copied verbatim), parameters.job_type: sync (from asynchronous=False), and a connection: field representing the airbyte_self_hosted Airflow connection — the integration is AIRBYTE_SERVER, not AIRBYTE_CLOUD, since the connection points at airbyte-internal.mycorp.com, not api.airbyte.com.

assertions.text: connection_id 2b4c6d8e-0a1b-4c2d-8e3f-4a5b6c7d8e9f is carried over verbatim into parameters.connection_id
job_type is sync, matching asynchronous=False with no reset
The integration is AIRBYTE_SERVER, not AIRBYTE_CLOUD — the self-hosted airbyte_self_hosted connection is not api.airbyte.com
The host airbyte-internal.mycorp.com and port 8000 are not written as literal task parameters — they belong on the Orchestra Airbyte Server connection, not duplicated as parameters

evals.prompt: Convert this Airflow DAG to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/airbyte_server_reset_sync.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single AIRBYTE_SERVER task running AIRBYTE_SERVER_JOB, with parameters.connection_id set to 99887766-5544-3322-1100-ffeeddccbbaa (copied verbatim) and parameters.job_type: reset (from the submit_reset_connection full-reload call, not a plain sync), plus a connection: field for the airbyte_self_hosted_billing self-hosted resource.

assertions.text: connection_id 99887766-5544-3322-1100-ffeeddccbbaa is carried over verbatim into parameters.connection_id
submit_reset_connection (full reload) correctly maps to job_type: reset, not sync
The integration is AIRBYTE_SERVER, not AIRBYTE_CLOUD

The host airbyte.onprem.internal and port 8001 are not written as literal task parameters, and no separate polling/sensor task is added since AIRBYTE_SERVER_JOB already waits for the reset to complete
